raw.rationale: TPCA-1 is a potent IKKβ/IKBKB inhibitor that suppresses NF-κB signaling, a pathway broadly required for survival across many cancer lineages, so at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is likely to show general cytotoxicity rather than strong lineage-selective killing; any selectivity would most plausibly arise in NF-κB-dependent lymphoid or inflammatory-cancer contexts, but none of the listed lineages are known to be uniquely IKKβ-addicted at this concentration.
